Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns a list of all employees with HTTP 200 status
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body is a JSON array
Verify each element in the array contains employee fields such as id, name, role, absent
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with a JSON array of employee objects

Title: Get single employee by valid ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns the employee details when a valid existing ID is provided
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains employee details with id=1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee object for id=1

Title: Get single employee with non-existing ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns 404 when employee with given ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status is 404 Not Found
Verify the response body contains message 'employee not found'
Expected Result: Response status 404 with JSON message 'employee not found'

Title: Create employee with valid data
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee creates a new employee when valid name and role are provided
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "Aman Gupt", "role": "Developer", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 201 Created
Verify the Location header contains URI of the created employee
Verify the response body contains the created employee with assigned id
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with Location header and created employee object

Title: Create employee with missing name and role
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee returns 400 Bad Request when name and role are missing or empty
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "", "role": "", "absent": ""}
Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'name and role are required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with JSON message 'name and role are required'

Title: Create employee with missing name
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee returns 400 Bad Request when name is missing but role is provided
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "", "role": "Developer", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'name and role are required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with JSON message 'name and role are required'

Title: Create employee with missing role
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee returns 400 Bad Request when role is missing but name is provided
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "Meera Singh", "role": "", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'name and role are required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with JSON message 'name and role are required'

Title: Update existing employee with valid data
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates employee details when valid id and body are provided
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with body {"name": "John Doe", "role": "Manager", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains updated employee details with id=1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with updated employee object

Title: Update non-existing employee
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} returns 404 Not Found when employee with given id does not exist
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/9999 with body {"name": "John Doe", "role": "Manager", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 404 Not Found
Verify the response body contains message 'employee not found'
Expected Result: Response status 404 with JSON message 'employee not found'

Title: Update employee with null request body
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} returns 400 Bad Request when request body is null
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with empty/null body
Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'request body is required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with JSON message 'request body is required'

Title: Delete existing employee
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} deletes the employee when a valid existing id is provided
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/1
Verify the response status is 204 No Content
Verify the employee with id=1 no longer exists
Expected Result: Response status 204 No Content and employee deleted

Title: Delete non-existing employee
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} returns 404 Not Found when employee with given id does not exist
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/9999
Verify the response status is 404 Not Found
Verify the response body contains message 'employee not found'
Expected Result: Response status 404 with JSON message 'employee not found'

Title: Create employee with boundary long name
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee accepts a long name at boundary length and creates employee successfully
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "VeryLongNameVeryLongNameVeryLongName", "role": "Senior Engineer", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 201 Created
Verify the response body contains the created employee with the long name
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with employee object containing the long name

Title: Get employee with negative ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} with negative id returns 404 Not Found or appropriate error
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/-1
Verify the response status is 404 Not Found
Verify the response body contains message 'employee not found'
Expected Result: Response status 404 with JSON message 'employee not found'

Title: Mark single attendance as present for valid employee and date
Description: Verify that marking attendance as present for a valid employeeId and date returns success with correct attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 1 exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId=1, absent=false, date=2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=1, absent=false, date=2025-01-01
Expected Result: Attendance record is created or updated with absent=false for employeeId=1 on 2025-01-01, response status 200

Title: Mark single attendance as absent for valid employee and date
Description: Verify that marking attendance as absent for a valid employeeId and date returns success with correct attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 2 exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId=2, absent=true, date=2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=2, absent=true, date=2025-01-01
Expected Result: Attendance record is created or updated with absent=true for employeeId=2 on 2025-01-01, response status 200

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns bad request error
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing absent=false, date=2025-01-02 but missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message indicating employeeId and absent are required
Expected Result: Response status 400 with error message 'employeeI and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with invalid employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance with invalid employeeId (-1) returns success or error depending on employee existence
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID -1 does not exist
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId=-1, absent=false, date=2025-01-03
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record is created or updated with employeeId=-1 and absent=false on 2025-01-03
Verify employee counters are not updated as employee does not exist
Expected Result: Attendance record created or updated with employeeId=-1, response status 200; employee counters unchanged

Title: Mark single attendance with future date boundary
Description: Verify that marking attendance on a far future date (2099-12-31) is accepted and processed correctly
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record contains employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31
Expected Result: Attendance record created or updated for employeeId=3 on 2099-12-31, response status 200

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid entries
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with multiple valid attendance records processes all correctly
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing attendance records for employeeId=1 (present) and employeeId=2 (absent) on 2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1, invalidEntries=[]
Verify savedRecords contain correct attendance entries for both employees
Expected Result: Both attendance records saved successfully, counts and invalidEntries reported correctly, response status 200

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that sending an empty list to batch attendance marking returns bad request error
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty array body []
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with error message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking processes valid entries and reports invalid employeeIds for invalid entries
Pre-Conditions: Employees with IDs 1 and 2 exist; employee with ID -1 does not exist
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing valid attendance for employeeId=1 and invalid attendance with missing employeeId and employeeId=-1
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount equals number of valid entries processed
Verify invalidEntries contains employeeId -1 only (missing employeeId entry is ignored)
Verify presentCount and absentCount reflect only valid saved records
Expected Result: Valid attendance saved, invalidEntries contains [-1], response status 200

Title: Mark batch attendance with future date boundary
Description: Verify batch attendance marking accepts attendance records with future date boundary
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing attendance record for employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=1, presentCount=1, absentCount=0, invalidEntries=[]
Verify savedRecords contains correct attendance record
Expected Result: Attendance record saved successfully for future date, response status 200
